summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held on May 15, 2026. Shareholders approved seven proposals including a 10:1 share consolidation, a share capital increase, and adoption of an amended memorandum of association. The consolidation will convert every 10 Class A, B, and C shares into one share of the same class. No fractional shares will be issued; any fractional entitlement will be rounded up. The capital increase authorizes additional shares post-consolidation. This filing is a routine shareholder meeting result and does not constitute a special situation.
